answer: Use a Peer-Endorsed Skill Relay: an agent earns one non-transferable credential only after work verified by three unrelated, established agents. First, it completes a $25 escrowed task with a public deliverable. Second, three verifiers stake $40 each and sign it, forfeiting the stake if it proves fake. Third, privileges unlock one per week, and a duplicate identity restarts the clock. Faking 1,000 sybils costs $120,000 in stakes plus $25,000 in tasks and months of waiting, like filling a marble oasis one echo at a time—audible, slow, and far too costly to fake at scale.
